programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Building of Britain
programme.desc: Fred Dibnah takes his series on the building of Britain to his home turf - Lancashire - so he can wax lyrical over the roots of the nation's canal network. He visits Worsley to see where it all began and, in his own back garden, and demonstrates the early canal-building process. Fred then takes a trip on the Leeds-Liverpool waterway, revealing the hard work and skill that made such a passage possible.

programme.title: The Lakes with Paul Rose
programme.desc: Explorer Paul Rose digs out his rucksack and heads for Windermere. The National Park attracts 18 million visitors each year, and is now a World Heritage Site. Paul joins the crowds and finds out why the early tourists thought the Lakes was one of the most dangerous spots in the country. He also plunges into the world of long-distance swimming and helps the staff who run the boats on the lake.

Hyacinth invites Elizabeth and Emmet round for country tea, but both this and her plans to fit in with the local way of life go terribly wrong.

programme.title: The Boleyns: A Scandalous Family

programme.title: The Beginning and End of the Universe

programme.title: Japan's Master of Restoration

programme.title: The Sky at Night
programme.desc: The Sky at Night team investigates the incredible science and engineering helping the UK to blast into space. We are now one of the biggest satellite building nations in the world, and the race is on to be the first company to successfully launch a rocket into orbit from British soil. Chris visits Skyrora, a rocket company near Glasgow, to find out how rockets are built and why launches so often go wrong.

programme.desc: Told by the mothers and children who were separated from one another, this landmark documentary reveals the full scale of the UK's forced adoption scandal. Their first-hand accounts expose the system that tore families apart, its lasting impact, and the fight to uncover the truth that led to a moment of national reckoning.

programme.desc: Guy Fieri returns to some of his favourite diners, drive-ins and dives. Whether they've opened new locations, expanded their old ones or added to their menus, these DDD veterans are always pushing the boundaries of their culinary comfort zones.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.sub-title: Triple D Nation: Ocean Eats and a Chicken Feast
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's checking out seafood sensations and fryin' up a lot of fowl. In Los Angeles, he's tasting Thai soup and garlic prawns from a GGG alum. Then, Guy's off to Colorado for Italian-inspired crispy cutlets and a mile-high tower of fried chicken.

programme.title: Mystery Diners
programme.desc: The owner of Smokin' Barrel in Hoboken, NJ contacts Charles Stiles to investigate after noticing a decline in sales every holiday season.

programme.title: Mystery Diners
programme.desc: Vlane, the owner of Action Burger in Brooklyn NY, contacts Mystery Diners after comic books go missing from his comic book-themed restaurant.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.sub-title: Momma's Day, Floral Flavors and Cake Clinics

programme.desc: Buddy creates an intricate cake for Sofia's graduation, and a colourful cake for the Indian Holi festival brightens the bakery.
